sloka: लङ्का चापि मया रात्रौ प्रविष्टा राक्षसाकुला ।रावणश्च मया दृष्टस्त्वं च शोकपरिप्लुता ।। ५.३५.७१।।।।
transliteration: laṅkā cāpi mayā rātrau praviṣṭā rākṣasākulā ।rāvaṇaśca mayā dṛṣṭastvaṁ ca śokapariplutā ।। 5.35.71।।।।

translations.english: "I entered at night the city of Lanka teeming with demons and saw Ravana and saw you immersed in sorrow.
